stories.title: Maharashtra medical counselling leaves 50 seats vacant
stories.summary: Maharashtra NEET UG counselling has concluded with 50 MBBS and BDS seats remaining vacant after three special stray vacancy rounds. While 99.56 percent of the 11,481 available seats were filled, the provisional seat matrix for BAMS, BHMS and BUMS courses currently shows 1,310 additional vacancies across various colleges.

stories.title: NTA sets UGC NET December 2026 exam schedule
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency will conduct the UGC NET December 2026 exam to determine eligibility for Junior Research Fellowships, Assistant Professor appointments and PhD admissions. The national-level test covers 87 subjects, with the agency recently issuing a revised notification regarding exam dates, city slips and admit card releases.

NEET 2027 exam date remains unconfirmed
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has not officially announced the exam date or application schedule for NEET 2027. While official confirmation is pending, the exam has historically taken place on the first Sunday of May, leading to speculation of a May 2, 2027, date for the upcoming cycle.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 session 1 registration deadline nears
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency will close registration for JEE Main 2027 Session 1 on November 22, 2026. Approximately 8.38 lakh candidates have completed fee payments so far. Applicants must have completed Class 12 in 2025 or 2026, or be currently enrolled in the 2027 academic year.

stories.title: NTA releases JEE Main 2027 exam schedule
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has scheduled JEE Main 2027 Session 1 for January 20 to 28, 2027, with Session 2 following from April 2 to 7. The official notification includes details on eligibility criteria and application timelines for the upcoming engineering entrance examinations.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration nears conclusion
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has received over 10.47 million registration forms for JEE Main 2027 Session 1, though only 8.38 million candidates have finalized fee payments. The registration window closes November 22, 2026, after which applicants may pay a 500 rupee late fee to participate.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 session 1 registration ends soon
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency will conclude registration for JEE Main 2027 Session 1 on November 22, 2026. Over 10.47 million forms have been submitted for the engineering entrance exam, which is scheduled to take place across six days in January 2027.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration statistics released
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency reports 10,47,083 total applications for JEE Main 2027 Session 1, with 8,38,138 candidates having completed the required fee payment. The deadline for submission without a late fee remains November 22, 2026. Final participation numbers are confirmed only after the examination concludes.

International student applications rebound on Common App
stories.summary: International student applications through the Common App are up 9 percent this year, reversing the decline seen between the 2024 and 2026 academic cycles. The increase suggests a return to the post-pandemic upward trajectory for foreign applicants seeking admission to United States colleges.

stories.title: Federal judge blocks restrictions on international student work
stories.summary: A federal judge in Massachusetts has suspended Department of Homeland Security directives that prevented international students from receiving academic credit for certain elective internships. The ruling allows universities to resume authorizing training opportunities while the lawsuit regarding the abrupt policy change proceeds.

stories.title: UK student visa applications drop 20 percent
stories.summary: The United Kingdom recorded 349,900 student visa applications by the end of October 2026, a 20 percent decline compared to the previous year. Applications from student dependants fell by 32 percent, as the government implements increasingly restrictive immigration policies.

stories.title: UK international student visa applications fall 31 percent
stories.summary: Sponsored study visa applications in the UK dropped 31 percent in October 2026 compared to the same month last year. Universities are currently preparing for a proposed 925 pound annual levy on international students, which is scheduled to take effect in August 2028.

stories.title: Federal court strikes down fixed visa stay limits
stories.summary: A federal district court in Massachusetts has ruled against a Department of Homeland Security regulation that sought to impose fixed stay limits on F, J and I visa holders. The court found the policy violated the Administrative Procedure Act and conflicted with Congressional intent.

stories.title: Court invalidates Trump-era foreign student visa rule
stories.summary: A federal court has struck down a rule that would have replaced the duration of status system with a four-year fixed admission period for international students. Judge F. Dennis Saylor IV described the Department of Homeland Security policy as arbitrary and capricious.

stories.title: Court blocks visa restrictions for international students
stories.summary: A federal court has temporarily barred the Trump administration from enforcing new restrictions on international student work authorizations. While the ruling provides an interim measure against the Department of Homeland Security directives, some universities have maintained their existing pauses on student training programs while the legal process continues.

stories.title: Judge halts Trump administration CPT internship curbs
stories.summary: A federal judge in Boston has temporarily blocked the Department of Homeland Security from enforcing stricter rules on Curricular Practical Training. The order serves as an interim measure while the court considers the legality of the restrictions, offering relief to students who rely on work-based learning programs.

stories.title: US universities face decline in international enrolment
stories.summary: New enrolment figures suggest the United States is losing its appeal as an international education destination. Universities report that restrictive immigration policies, visa uncertainty and increased scrutiny of foreign students are shifting the landscape for institutions that previously relied on global talent to support research and the economy.

stories.title: Judge rules against DHS policy on student training
stories.summary: A federal judge has ruled that higher education groups suing to strike down new limits on the Curricular Practical Training program are likely to succeed. The decision marks a significant legal hurdle for the Department of Homeland Security policy aimed at restricting international student training opportunities.

stories.title: Federal court strikes down DHS student visa restrictions, but uncertainty persists for Georgetown’s international studen
Judge strikes down visa limits for students and press
stories.summary: A federal judge has thrown out an attempt to limit visas for international students and foreign journalists. Judge Dennis Saylor ruled the government failed to prove widespread visa fraud or national security concerns, describing the Department of Homeland Security's move as arbitrary and capricious.

stories.title: Girls On Campus offers leadership scholarship
stories.summary: Girls On Campus is accepting applications for a $1,500 scholarship for female students planning to attend a US college or university in fall 2027. The program prioritizes demonstrated leadership and community initiative over traditional academic awards or major achievements.

stories.title: UAH opens applications for cybersecurity scholarships
stories.summary: The University of Alabama in Huntsville is accepting applications for cybersecurity scholarships for the fall 2027 semester. The program, funded by the National Science Foundation and the Department of War, covers full tuition and fees while providing a cost-of-living stipend for eligible students.

stories.title: Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for design
stories.summary: College Mentor is providing information on the Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for students pursuing design and architecture. The platform connects applicants with mentors who share professional insights and educational content to assist with the application process.

stories.title: Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for law
stories.summary: College Mentor is providing details on the Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for integrated law courses for the 2026-27 academic year. The platform offers access to mentors who provide guidance on eligibility and the application process for prospective students.

stories.title: NAPB-APBA Borlaug scholarship for African PhD students
stories.summary: The NAPB Borlaug Scholars-Africa Programme is accepting applications from African PhD students in plant breeding. The competitive scholarship provides financial support, international exposure and professional mentorship to six doctoral researchers over a two-year period to nurture the next generation of agricultural scientists.

stories.title: OTEC opens 2027 scholarship applications
stories.summary: The Oregon Trail Electric Cooperative has opened applications for its 2027 student scholarships. The program offers financial support to local students ranging from high school graduates to current college attendees, with additional funding available for those pursuing vocational or technical trade school education.

stories.title: Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for graduation
stories.summary: College Mentor is offering guidance on the Buddy4Study India Foundation scholarship for general graduation students for the 2026-27 academic year. The program connects applicants with mentors to help navigate eligibility requirements and the application process.

stories.title: Oxford offers fully funded law scholarship
stories.summary: The University of Oxford has announced the Feltham Scholarship for the 2027-28 academic year. The award covers course fees and maintenance costs for one postgraduate law student, with preference given to those pursuing the Bachelor of Civil Law program.

stories.title: Wageningen University opens Africa Scholarship Programme
stories.summary: Wageningen University and Research in the Netherlands is accepting applications for its Africa Scholarship Programme for 2027. The fully funded initiative covers tuition, living allowances, airfare and insurance for African students pursuing master's degrees in life sciences, agriculture and environmental studies.

stories.title: Cambridge offers master's scholarship for Indian students
stories.summary: The University of Cambridge is offering the Pemanda Monappa Scholarship for Indian students pursuing master's degrees in selected disciplines, including law. The award covers international tuition fees and maintenance allowances, with priority for students connected to Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala or Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: Oxford offers Merton Lawyers' BCL scholarships
stories.summary: The University of Oxford is offering two scholarships worth £10,000 each for students admitted to the Bachelor of Civil Law program for the 2027-28 academic year. Both UK and international applicants are automatically considered for the awards upon admission.

stories.title: Wageningen University offers master's scholarships
stories.summary: Wageningen University and Research has opened applications for its Africa Scholarship Programme for 2027. The fully funded master's degree opportunity covers tuition, living costs and travel for high-achieving students who hold first-class honours or an equivalent GPA of at least 80 percent.

stories.title: QS releases 2027 sustainability rankings
stories.summary: QS Quacquarelli Symonds has released its 2027 sustainability rankings covering 2,000 universities. Sweden's Lund University holds the top spot, while the University of Toronto dropped to third. The US remains the most represented system, though the rankings arrive as only 36 percent of UN sustainability goals remain measurable.

stories.title: India to release 2026 engineering rankings in November
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education expects to release its 2026 NIRF engineering rankings in late November. The list will provide performance metrics for institutions across India, including IITs and NITs. Students can access the data on the official government portal to compare institutional bands and performance tiers.

stories.title: Indian universities see sustainability ranking gains
stories.summary: India saw 38 universities improve their standing in the 2027 QS sustainability rankings, marking a 4 percent net improvement. Despite this growth, India has no universities in the global top 100 and only one in the top 200. Improvement is relative to a global field.

stories.title: Kazakhstan doubles university presence in THE rankings
stories.summary: The Ministry of Science and Higher Education of Kazakhstan reported that 10 local universities are featured in the 2027 Times Higher Education World University Rankings. This represents a doubling of the country's representation compared to the previous year's list.

stories.title: University of Santo Tomas retains sustainability ranking
stories.summary: The University of Santo Tomas remains the fourth-ranked school in the Philippines in the 2027 QS sustainability rankings. The university achieved an overall score of 62.1, rising to 810th place globally. It recorded its highest individual indicator score in equality, at 91.6 out of 100.

stories.title: Duke highlights interdisciplinary science success
stories.summary: Duke University credits its 2027 interdisciplinary science ranking to decades of structural investment. The university maintains specific administrative support and promotion standards designed to reward interdisciplinary scholarship. Officials state these internal conditions are what allow their collaborative research model to thrive.

stories.title: University of Queensland climbs sustainability rankings
stories.summary: The University of Queensland rose 22 places to 28th globally in the 2027 QS sustainability rankings. The institution ranked equal first for health and wellbeing impact and second nationally for environmental research. The rankings weigh environmental impact, social impact and governance metrics.

stories.title: Taibah University improves in science rankings
stories.summary: Taibah University reached 164th place in the 2027 Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings. This marks an 87-place rise from its previous position in the 251 to 300 band. The university attributed the change to improved performance in interdisciplinary scientific research output.

stories.title: Carnegie Mellon ranks fifth in interdisciplinary science
stories.summary: Carnegie Mellon University placed fifth globally in the 2027 Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings. As the highest-ranked first-time participant, the university was recognized for its research across fields. The rankings were produced in association with Schmidt Science Fellows to benchmark institutional impact.

stories.title: University of Lagos rises in sustainability rankings
stories.summary: The University of Lagos rose over 700 places to rank 697th in the 2027 QS sustainability rankings. Previously in the 1,401 to 1,500 band, the university improved across all 11 assessed indicators. It now ranks as the highest-placed institution in Nigeria.

stories.title: UBC maintains high sustainability ranking
stories.summary: The University of British Columbia continues to score among the top institutions in the 2027 QS sustainability rankings. The school is evaluated on environmental impact, social impact and governance. It currently trails an Ontario institution for the top spot in Canada.

stories.title: Covenant University leads African institutions in science rankings
stories.summary: Covenant University retained its position as the top-ranked African institution in the 2027 Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings. The university is placed joint 49th globally. Nigeria saw its total number of ranked universities increase from 18 to 27 this year.

stories.title: Cluster university model struggles to scale
stories.summary: India's decade-old cluster university policy has resulted in only eight surviving institutions from a planned 400. Funding strains, staffing challenges and rule confusion have led several states to dismantle their clusters and revert to standard university models. The policy remains an ongoing experiment.

Philippines opens medical exams to Indian graduates
stories.summary: Indian medical graduates from recognized Philippine institutions may now sit for the Physician Licensure Examination. The decision allows for registration to practice medicine in the Philippines. The move follows confirmation from the Indian Ambassador regarding a reciprocal arrangement between the two nations.

stories.title: Madras High Court clarifies NEET stay
stories.summary: The Madras High Court clarified that its interim stay on postgraduate medical counselling applies only to Sri Venkateshwaraa Deemed University. The court confirmed that the order does not affect the counselling processes conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee or the Centralised Admission Committee for other institutions.

stories.title: UGC advises students to verify university status
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued a public advisory urging students to verify the legal status of institutions before enrolling. The directive follows a Supreme Court order and warns against relying solely on advertisements or websites. The commission suggests checking official recognition status directly.

stories.title: UGC Issues Advisory for Students, Parents, Releases List of Fake Universities - Telegraph India
UGC advises students to verify university credentials
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued an advisory warning students and parents against relying on advertisements, social media posts, or brochures when choosing a college. The regulator suggests checking official websites to verify recognition and approval status. The advice follows a recent Supreme Court case regarding fake colleges.

stories.title: MCC puts NEET PG round 2 seat allotment on hold
stories.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee has placed the NEET PG 2026 round 2 seat allotment results on hold. New dates for the results and reporting process will be announced on the official website. The committee plans to release a provisional result first to allow for student grievances.

stories.title: Will Class 10 and 12 Board Exam Dates 2027 be Postponed Due to Census Schedule? Check Updates - Shiksha.com
NEET PG counselling results delayed
stories.summary: The National Board of Examinations conducts the NEET PG 2026 for admission to over 40,000 postgraduate medical seats across government and private institutions. The Medical Counselling Committee has delayed the round 2 seat allotment results. A new date for the release is pending on the official website.

stories.title: UGC warns public to check college status
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has urged students and parents to verify the legal status of educational institutions before paying fees or enrolling. The advisory follows a Supreme Court order concerning fake colleges. The regulator suggests that marketing materials are not a substitute for checking official government recognition records.

stories.title: Government plans 75,000 new medical seats by 2029
stories.summary: Union Health Minister J P Nadda stated that the government intends to create 75,000 additional medical seats by 2029. He noted that undergraduate seats have grown to 1.43 lakh and postgraduate seats to 91,000 over the past decade. The expansion aims to increase national medical education infrastructure.

Complainants aged 60 and older reported \$4.9 billion in losses in 2024 to the U.S. Internet Crime Complaint Center. To investigate family intervention barriers. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A conceptual framework for ideology in online discourse beyond the left and right
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Computational social science (CSS) has largely operationalized ideology along a single left/right partisan axis when studying online discourse. This approach obscures how people interpret and engage with more specific ideological formations related to race, climate, gender. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The power density of AI workloads is rapidly driving shifts to liquid cooling. This study rethinks and assesses the global impact on energy and water demand of this cooling transformation. Results suggest that liquid cooling can. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Decent Work Standards and Non-Conventional Work: Measurement Gaps and Uneven Capability Formation in Kenya's Online Platform Labour Markets
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Online freelancing through digital platforms is a precarious but sought-after livelihood pathway in contexts with weaker conventional labour markets. This article examines how worker-level decent-work assessments intersect with livelihood strategies and outcomes among experienced online freelancers. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Disarranged Harmonization of Transparency Reporting by Social Media Platforms Under the Digital Services Act
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: The European Commission recently introduced new regulation to harmonize transparency reporting of large online platforms under the Digital Services Act (DSA). Here, we present the first systematic evaluation of transparency reporting data quality after this normative. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: From Defense to Advocacy: Empowering Users to Leverage the Blind Spot of AI Inference
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Most privacy regulations function as a passive defensive shield that users must wield themselves. Users are incessantly asked to "opt-in" or "opt-out" of data collection, forced to make defensive decisions whose consequences are increasingly difficult to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Large language models create an uneven informational layer over cities
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are emerging as a new informational layer over cities, shaping which places people discover, consider, and ultimately visit. Yet little is known about which places they surface, which they ignore, and whether. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
